items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: A critical vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code. This zero-day flaw has been actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including security feature bypass and privilege escalation issues. Adobe recommends applying the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650 in addition to these updates.

items.title: Persistent Backdoors via CosmicSting Attack
items.summary: Sansec reported ongoing widespread attacks leveraging CosmicSting, a significant vulnerability leading to the injection of persistent backdoors on Adobe Commerce stores. While the CVE is older, active exploitation and recent reporting highlight its severity.

items.title: Critical Magento Account Takeover
items.summary: Adobe released isolated patch files addressing seven vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1.

items.title: Multiple Critical Vulnerabilities in Amasty Extensions
items.summary: Amasty issued a massive security release for dozens of its Magento extensions, with two critical vulnerabilities that could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento full-page cache extension.
